changelog: Initial release of ACN EMS v3 featuring real-time 3D ballistic bone trauma and localized limb pain alerts.
Added interactive 3D Limb Surgery Suite with 3D bullet extraction, point-by-point 3D wound suturing, and 3D X-Ray fracture alignment.
Added 60 FPS world-space 3D bone camera zoom and holographic diagnostic pins directly anchored to GTA V player bones.
Added full in-game live configuration (/conf_acn_emsv3) with interactive 3D Raycast and 3D Axis Gizmo placement.
